abstract: A statistical survey is presented of brain tumors diagnosed in the first year of life (from five Far-Eastern countries) in relation to the racial differences in tumor types, congenital factors, and general clinical features. Of the 307 cases collected, 262 were verified histologically, and astrocytomas comprised 23.3%, medulloblastomas 17.2%, ependymomas 11.1%, choroid plexus papillomas 10.7%, teratomas 8.4%, primitive neuroectodermal tumors 4.2%, meningiomas 2.3%, and others 22.9%. There were statistically significant racial differences in comparison with the worldwide survey done by the International Society for Pediatric Neurosurgery Education Committee (1987) on the same subject. In the Far-Eastern population, medulloblastoma and teratoma were more common (P less than 0.05), whereas astrocytoma was less frequent (P less than 0.01) than reported in the worldwide survey. The malformative factors were suggested in 18 cases in which various associated congenital anomalies were observed. Vascular anomalous lesions, mostly in the extracranial organs, were most common, comprising 61.1% of the associated malformations. Hereditary factors were less commonly demonstrated in these tumors than were anomalies in the major congenital central nervous system. Among the 307 cases, there was one instance (0.3%) of nearly identical tumors occurring in twin brothers. The specific clinical manifestations of brain tumors involving the immature brain were again apparent in this survey, as were the poor survival rates and poor functional prognosis.
abstract_ja: 極東5か国から収集された生後1年以内に診断された脳腫瘍の統計調査を提示する。症例307例のうち262例が組織学的に確認された。星細胞腫23.3%、髄芽腫17.2%、上衣腫11.1%、脈絡叢乳頭腫10.7%、奇形腫8.4%、原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍4.2%、髄膜腫2.3%、その他22.9%であった。国際小児神経外科教育委員会（1987）による世界的調査と比較して、腫瘍型に統計的に有意な人種差が認められた。極東集団では髄芽腫と奇形腫がより多く（P<0.05）、星細胞腫は少なかった（P<0.01）。18例で奇形性因子が示唆され、さまざまな先天奇形が認められた。奇形に伴う病変のうち、頭蓋外臓器の血管異常病変が最も多く、61.1%を占めた。これらの腫瘍では遺伝因子は、中枢神経系の主要な先天奇形に比べ認められることは少なかった。307例中、双生児の兄弟にほぼ同一の腫瘍が発生した例が1例（0.3%）あった。未熟な脳に発生する脳腫瘍に特有の臨床像が本調査でも再び確認され、生存率の低さと機能予後の不良も明らかとなった。
